scope: Geometric projected silhouette union of actual triangles at four fixed orthographic views, 512px; excludes shadows/texture/lighting. Frozen comparison carrier is untouched.

uv_comparison.main_mapping_formula: Same directional stave mapping and lid mapping; no atlas rebake. LOD removes chamfer/rivet topology and lowers lid perimeter subdivisions.
uv_comparison.qualification: Only retained positions within 1e-6m are compared; removed/new chamfer positions do not have 1:1 UV correspondences.

remaining_test: Unity import, scene/camera distance LOD transitions, TAA, project cel shader, collision, phone frame/memory budgets not tested
